source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved AMD CRB Board BIOS values persist across save/reboot and return to board-revision-specific SPEC defaults after Load Default without losing board resources, attached devices, boot or management access.
original_method: Change fields on ADVANCE CRB Board, save/reboot and re-enter BIOS to verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare the page with SPEC while checking normal reboot and logs.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the AMD CRB Board page, set each approved value, perform both save/reboot cycles, select Load Default and inspect firmware values. Automated device inventory cannot substitute for that UI path.
required_inputs: Exact AMD platform, board revision and BIOS build
Named CRB fields with baseline, safe non-default and revision-specific SPEC-default values
Console/operator, stable power and OOB/vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; approve every CRB field and value for the exact board revision.
Do not copy defaults or field semantics from a different AMD reference/customer board.
Protect required storage, network, accelerator and management paths from unreviewed disablement or remapping.
Stop on device loss, hang, crash, boot or management failure.
Restore the approved final board configuration.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only platform IDs, PCI/device topology, OS/BMC logs and health evidence.
Compare operator firmware captures and device inventory against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, choose board controls, infer vendor-private defaults or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Obtain and approve the revision-correct CRB field/default matrix and recovery path.
Perform/capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate board/device behavior and set the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent control of the pre-OS workflow. No source command exists; read-only device/PCI inventory is supportive and must be selected for the installed OS.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the actual CRB firmware page and add revision-tagged read-only board/device snapshots; do not use OS device toggles or firmware-variable writes as substitutes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, AMD test set, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains preserved source text but is not a safe executable plan.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each approved CRB field to board/BIOS revision, baseline, non-default, SPEC default and expected resource/device effect; capture firmware and device topology through persistence, default restoration and final-state phases.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact AMD board/CRB implementation represented by the SUT, not AMD platforms generally.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU family, board revision, BIOS/AGESA-equivalent identification, BMC, OS and inventory-tool versions without inventing unsupported vendor fields.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/vendor CRB Board specification for the exact platform revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds revision binding and causal device checks and rejects arbitrary setting selection while retaining the source state transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction for the approved matrix; excluded fields and any project-limited subset are reported explicitly.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Revision-correct vendor matrix and resource/device expectations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CRB menus may expose engineering controls whose semantics are vendor-private; public generic AMD information is not enough to approve them.

project_override_considerations: The project may scope a safe field subset and topology-specific health checks. It must record that coverage and cannot generalize results across board revisions or claim all CRB controls were validated.
expected_evidence: Platform/board/BIOS identity, approval and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence captures and device topology
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and normal-boot evidence
Final board/device/management state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Procedure and Criteria consistently describe persistence and default restoration. Their missing CRB field/revision definitions are required inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent is identifiable. Exact board documentation and values gate safe execution but, under V3.1, do not make a common library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds board-revision and resource-impact specificity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its bounded matrix, device evidence and recovery controls while treating absent project inputs as readiness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Constrains conclusions to one board revision and separates supporting automation from the manual core.

review_improvement: Prevents engineering-only CRB controls or another revision's defaults from being applied blindly and makes device/resource regressions visible.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware page manipulation and the decisive persistence/default observations are pre-OS and human-executed, so MANUAL ONLY applies. The CRB-specific risk is board-resource behavior, distinct from the adjacent generic ACPI page.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat any CRB field write, reboot or default load after unexpected device/resource or boot behavior; preserve first-transition evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
